flags.summary: The rep disclosed a tier ladder that does not exist in the stated offer — $2,000 per year for a do-it-yourself product and $4,000 for three months of one-to-one — plus unspecified higher options, against a stated offer of $6,000/6mo and $9,000/12mo.
evidence: I do know that we also have on the lower end. So we have a do it yourself way that is 2k per year and a three months that is 4k.
Oh, it can be four, but that would be for three months.
But if you want to make sure you have the full transformation, we always go for the six months overall.
Yeah. But there's also higher options available. The six is just the best suitable for basically everyone that we work with.
So there were other options available. You just went right at the six. I get it.

flags.summary: An automated pre-call text thread told the prospect the price was between two and four thousand; he discovered the discrepancy when the rep quoted $6,000 and told the rep to stop setting expectations that way.
evidence: So when it comes to the investment, it is six. Questions on that? Why was I told that it was between two and four?
By who? I got it in the text message thread.
Where did the variation and what I was told in the text message and what you're telling me now come in? I don't know exactly what the text message is, to be honest.

You said somebody set expectations in that text message thread, and then I come in and it's not exactly what was exposed to me before. Whoever's answering those texts, you might want to have them not set expectations with people that way.
So I guess that's where Sophia took that from.

flags.summary: The rep stated that the company does not take calls with people in cars because of safety, then ran the full thirty-minute discovery and pitch with the prospect in his car on the way to a flight.
evidence: I can, and I'm sorry, I'm not on camera. I'm moving around right now. We had to move this call from Friday, so I'm in transit.
we don't usually take calls when people are in the car, just overall. Not even outside of seeing each other, it also comes down to safety, etc. Does that make sense?
I'd like to continue with this time right now before I get on an airplane.
Okay, perfect. Let's do it like this and then we can just have a phone conversation. So tell me, what can we actually potentially help you with, Brian?
